newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafinsa foreign debt totals $15 billion.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafinsa foreign debt totals $15 billion.

text.p: The total foreign debt accrued by Mexican Development Bank Nafinsa reached $15 billion at the end of May, the bank's international director Roberto Casillas said on Friday.
"The gross figure of Nafinsa's external debt is a little more than $15 billion in round figures," he told Reuters.
$11 billion of this amount represents money owed to the World Bank and the Inter-American Development Bank as a result of Nafin's role as financial agent for the Mexican government.
"The other 15 percent comes from operations Nafin has with various import-export banks around the world," Casillas said in an interview.
At present Nafinsa has some 20 credit lines open with different banks dedicated to supporting exports.
He added that the remaining 15 percent, equivalent to $2 billion, comes from debt accumulated in the international markets.
In May, Nafin launched a $150 million three-year Eurobond with an 8.0 percent coupon priced at 140 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
